The '''TSMEU-6 personal wheel bike''', also known simply as the '''TSMEU-6 wheel bike''', or '''wheel bike''', was a model of personal wheel bike manufactured by the [[Z-Gomot Ternbuell Guppat Corporation]]. During the [[Clone Wars]], [[General Grievous' TSMEU-6 Wheel Bike|one]] was owned by [[Kaleesh]] [[droid]] leader [[General]] [[Grievous]] while others were used by [[BX-series droid commando]]s and [[IG-100 MagnaGuard]]s.

==Characteristics==
[[File:WheelBikeControlPanel.png|thumb|left|200px|Wheel bike control panel.]]
The military vehicle's steering controls are housed in an illuminated, touch-sensitive console that—in the case of [[General Grievous' TSMEU-6 Wheel Bike]]—were been strengthened to withstand [[General]] [[Grievous]]' keen metal fingertips. The color perception of Grievous' [[species]], the [[Kaleesh]], [[eye]]sight is changed in the console graphic display.<ref name="Complete Vehicles">[[Star Wars: Complete Vehicles (2016)|''Star Wars: Complete Vehicles'' (2016)]]</ref> The TSMEU-6 personal wheel bike,<ref name="Ultimate Star Wars" /> also known simply as the TSMEU-6 wheel bike,<ref name="Roadmap" /> or the wheel bike,<ref name="Grievous SWE">{{SWE|characters|generalgrievous|General Grievous}}</ref> was a descendant of the [[InterGalactic Banking Clan]]'s hoop-wheeled [[IG-227 Hailfire-class droid tank|Hailfire droids]], which are designed to roll at intimidating speed on hard surfaces. On Grievous' personal wheel bike, the seat's soft padding was removed as it was unnecessary for Grievous's purposes. Its place has been taken by magnetic panels that held Grievous' metallic body to the vehicle.<ref name="Complete Vehicles" />

The bike had four retractable [[Limb|legs]] that allowed it to climb steep inclines and was armed with a double [[laser cannon]] replacing the passenger seat.<ref name="Ultimate Star Wars" /> On his personal wheel bike, Grievous could wield either a conveniently placed [[electrostaff]], a [[blaster]], or one of his [[Jedi]] [[lightsaber]]s [[Collector|trophies]] when he rolls into battle.<ref name="Complete Vehicles" /> It proved popular in [[mining]] areas, as it facilitated long-distance underground travel over a variety of terrains.<ref name="Ultimate Star Wars" /> In the [[Separatist Droid Army]], TSMEU-6 wheel bikes were fielded as cavalry that provided speed and ferocity on the frontline, with the vehicles being operated by [[BX-series droid commando]]s and [[IG-100 MagnaGuard]]s.<ref name="MinistravLegion">{{AtomicMassGames|url=transmission/star-wars-legion-ministravaganza-2025-previews|text=Star Wars: Legion Ministravaganza 2025 Previews}}</ref>

==History==
[[File:TSMEU6PersonalWheelBikes-SWQ32.png|thumb|250px|right|A BX-series droid commando and IG-100 MagnaGuard riding TSMEU-6 personal wheel bikes.]]
TSMEU-6 personal wheel bikes were used by members of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. On one occasion, an IG-100 MagnaGuard and BX-series droid [[commando]] both rode TSMEU-6 wheel bikes over a rocky environment.<ref name="Roadmap" /> [[General]] [[Grievous]] himself made use of a wheel bike, debuting his TSMEU-6 at the [[Battle of Parein II 4]]<ref name="Ships and Vehicles (2)">{{EncyclopediaCite|Miscellaneous Ships and Vehicles (2)}}</ref> and once using it to chase down an [[All Terrain Reconnaissance Transport]]-riding [[Advanced Recon Force trooper|ARF Trooper]].<ref name="Roadmap" /> Grievous also used his wheel bike during the [[invasion of Utapau]].<ref name="Databank">{{Databank|general-grievous-tsmeu-6-wheel-bike|General Grievous' TSMEU-6 Wheel Bike}}</ref> Sometime later, the Confederacy had at least three TSMEU-6s in their possession inside of a [[Unidentified core ship|modified core ship]] on [[Utapau]]. Grievous used one of these during the [[Battle of Utapau]]<ref name="Episode III" /> in [[19 BBY]]. In [[0 ABY]],<ref name="Timelines">''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]''</ref> a wrecked wheel bike was amongst the piles of wreckages in the [[Cymoon 1 refuse fields|refuse fields]] of the [[moon]] [[Cymoon 1]], where the [[Galactic Empire]] had established use of [[Weapons Factory Alpha]].<ref name="Star Wars 1">[[Star Wars (2015) 1|''Star Wars'' (2015) 1]]</ref>
